Trash Dash! · Privacy policy

Trash Dash! support

Need help or want to report a problem? Email trashdash@replayeverymemory.com.

What to include

Tell us your device model, operating-system version, game version/build, and the chapter or stage where the problem happened. Describe what you expected and what happened instead. Screenshots or a short recording can help; please avoid including personal information.

If you are using TestFlight, you can also send feedback through TestFlight. Include the build number so we can identify the version you played.

Controls and comfort settings

Open Options from the main menu, or use the pause menu during play. The available options depend on the build and input device. Check Controls for the actions and choices available in your version.

Continuing your journey

Choose Continue from the main menu. If progress appears to be missing, contact us with what you last completed and your build number. Avoid deleting the app while investigating a save problem, because that may remove local progress.

Release news

Visit our games page or @replayeverymemory on Instagram. Availability is confirmed through the actual store listing when published.

Good memories
start with hello.

Follow our little studio, see what we’re dreaming up, or simply drop us a line. We’d love to hear from you.

We keep this site simple and privacy-conscious: no ad pixels, behavioral tracking, or unnecessary cookies.
